_about: buddy config: one block per step, every setting at its default (explained in TUTORIAL.md, section 5)
_values: true / false switch a setting on or off; null = not set, buddy decides (threshold null = automatic, dic_rotation null = measured per image, ash_channel null in cell_cycle = the ash_channel of bud_classification)

channels._about: step 1 (read): filter = channel name in the microscope file, threshold null = automatic, tiff_channel for TIFF stacks

spots._about: step 3 (spots): scale and spot_radius (z, y, x) in nm, sigma (z, y, x) in px - required; patch_size for the in-focus planes; decomposition of dense regions (Big-FISH alpha, beta, gamma), the same for every channel

segmentation._about: step 2 (segment): Omnipose and the mask clean-up. use_preset true = the organism's Omnipose settings (cells / nuclei show them); to tune, set use_preset false and edit cells / nuclei

bud_classification._about: step 3, bud model: DIC_DAPI_only (any strain) or with_ASH1CLB2 (not for she2/she3); enabled: false = annotate buds by hand

cell_cycle._about: cell-cycle phase per cell: G1 (unbudded, <= g1_max_ash ASH1/CLB2), S / G2 / M by bud area (um2)

hardware._about: use_gpu: Omnipose + bud model; gpu_spot_detection: the spot steps; without a GPU all runs on the CPU

tiff_input._about: step 1, TIFF stacks only: the DIC channel inside the stack and the axis order when the file does not say
